subject: Web Development
title: HTML Parsing: From Text to Tree
description: A fast breakdown of HTML Parsing: From Text to Tree for builders.

hook.text: HTML arrives as a stream of characters. The browser must turn it into something useful.

buildup.text: A tokenizer breaks the text into tags, attributes, and content pieces.

discovery.text: Those tokens are assembled into a tree structure called the DOM — the Document Object Model.

twist.text: Malformed HTML doesn't crash. Browsers have error recovery rules to fix bad markup silently.

climax.text: The DOM becomes the living structure that JavaScript reads, edits, and reacts to.

punchline.text: Messy HTML in, perfect tree out.
